title: 第15章 战神临校血色预感应劫数第16章 黑风试炼天机本能破死局
lines: 四大战神莅临天元学府演讲的消息，让整座学府从上至下彻底沸腾。
天色未亮，大礼堂门口便已排起长龙，学子们手持纸笔、满怀期许，人人都盼着能亲眼目睹战神风采、聆听英雄教诲，甚至求得一纸签名，近距离感受龙国顶尖强者的风范。
庄周带着小蝶一同前往礼堂。
小蝶始终紧紧牵着庄周的手掌，懵懂好奇地打量着周遭热闹的景象，对世间万物都充满新鲜感，仰头轻声询问众人等候的缘由。
庄周耐心温柔地为她讲解，告知她四大战神是守护龙国山河、庇护万千百姓的顶级英雄，是龙国所有人的信仰与荣光。
就在二人闲谈之际，人群骤然掀起巨大骚动，所有人的目光齐刷刷聚焦在校门口方向。
四辆黑色越野车缓缓驶来，稳稳停靠在大礼堂门前。
车门次第开启，四道风华绝代、气场迥异的身影依次下车，瞬间攫住全场所有目光。
为首的关羽身披青绿战袍，手持青龙偃月刀，面容刚毅正气，眼神锐利如锋，周身萦绕着凛然浩然的正气，让人肃然起敬。
紧随其后的吕布身披银白铠甲，手持方天画戟，面容俊朗桀骜，周身气场睥睨天下、霸气无双。
第三位的项羽身披黑色披风，手持霸王长枪，身形魁梧挺拔，气势磅礴浩荡，自带一往无前的绝世战意。
最后而出的李元霸身着黄色短打，手持一对震天擂鼓瓮金锤，身形看似憨厚朴实，眼底却暗藏一丝桀骜疯狂，战力骇人。
四大战神现身的瞬间，全场爆发出山呼海啸般的欢呼，学子们高声呐喊着四位英雄的名号，声浪震耳欲聋、久久不息。
四大战神微微颔首示意，在校长与一众导师的陪同下，从容步入大礼堂。
庄周牵着好奇懵懂的小蝶，跟随人流缓步走入礼堂。
偌大的礼堂座无虚席、人山人海，就连过道都站满了学子，二人只能立于最后一排观望。
众人落座完毕，校长登台致辞，隆重介绍四大战神的到来，再次点燃全场氛围。
掌声停歇后，关羽率先登台演讲，嗓音洪亮铿锵、字字千钧，通篇不谈浮华大道理，只着重阐释“忠义”二字的真谛。
忠于家国、忠于万民，为守护山河故土甘愿以身赴死；义薄云天、情系手足，为并肩战友可以两肋插刀。
他细数镇守边境数十年的峥嵘岁月，大小数百次浴血奋战，身边战友前赴后继、壮烈牺牲，却从未有人退缩半步。
只因身后是家国百姓、是至亲故土，他们退无可退、别无选择。
他殷殷嘱托在场少年学子，身为龙国后辈，当铭记血脉初心，终身忠于家国、不负故土。
一番赤诚恳切的发言直击人心，全场鸦雀无声、人人动容，不少学子热泪盈眶，心底的家国情怀被彻底点燃。
演讲落幕之际，掌声经久不息、回荡全场。
紧随其后登台的吕布风格截然不同，神色桀骜、言语犀利，直言乱世修行、实力为尊。
content_en:
The news that the four war gods came to Tianyuan Academy to give speeches made the entire academy boil with excitement from top to bottom.
Before dawn, there was already a long queue at the entrance of the auditorium. The students held pens and papers in hand and were full of expectations. Everyone was looking forward to seeing the God of War with their own eyes, listening to the hero's teachings, and even getting an autograph to experience the style of the top powerhouses of the Dragon Kingdom up close.
Zhuang Zhou took Xiaodie to the auditorium.
Xiaodie always held Zhuang Zhou's hand tightly, looking at the lively scene around her with ignorance and curiosity. She was full of freshness about everything in the world. She raised her head and asked softly why everyone was waiting.
Zhuang Zhou explained to her patiently and gently, telling her that the four war gods are the top heroes who protect the mountains and rivers of the Dragon Kingdom and protect thousands of people. They are the faith and glory of everyone in the Dragon Kingdom.
Just as the two were chatting, the crowd suddenly made a huge commotion, and everyone's eyes were focused on the direction of the school gate.
Four black off-road vehicles drove slowly and parked steadily in front of the auditorium.
The car doors opened one after another, and four figures with extraordinary elegance and different auras got out of the car one after another, instantly grabbing the attention of everyone present.
The leader, Guan Yu, was wearing a green war robe and holding a Qinglong Yanyue Sword. His face was resolute and upright, his eyes were as sharp as sharp edges, and he was surrounded by awe-inspiring righteousness, which made people awe-inspiring.
Lu Bu, who followed closely behind, was wearing silver-white armor and holding a Fangtian painted halberd. His face was handsome and unruly, and his aura looked down on the world and was unparalleled in domineering.
Xiang Yu, who is in third place, wears a black cloak and holds an overlord spear. He is tall and tall, with majestic momentum and unparalleled fighting spirit.
Li Yuanba, who came out last, was wearing a yellow bunt and holding a pair of thundering drums and golden hammers. His figure seemed honest and simple, but there was a hint of unruly madness in his eyes, and his fighting power was terrifying.
The moment the four war gods appeared, the audience burst into cheers like a mountain roar and a tsunami. The students shouted the names of the four heroes loudly, and the sound was deafening and lasted for a long time.
The four war gods nodded slightly and walked calmly into the auditorium accompanied by the principal and a group of instructors.
Zhuang Zhou held the curious and ignorant Xiaodie and slowly walked into the auditorium following the flow of people.
The huge auditorium was packed with seats and crowds of people. Even the aisles were filled with students. The two of them could only stand in the last row and watch.
After everyone was seated, the principal took the stage to deliver a speech, grandly introducing the arrival of the four war gods, which once again ignited the atmosphere of the entire venue.
After the applause stopped, Guan Yu was the first to take the stage to give a speech. His voice was sonorous and his every word was precise. He did not talk about flashy principles throughout the article, but only focused on explaining the true meaning of the word "loyalty and righteousness".
Loyal to the country and the people, willing to die to protect the mountains, rivers and homeland; loyal to the heavens and close to brothers, willing to stand by his comrades at all costs.
He recounted the turbulent years of guarding the border for decades, hundreds of bloody battles, big and small, and the comrades around him who fought and sacrificed heroically, but no one ever retreated even a step.
Just because behind them are the people of their home country and their close relatives and homeland, they have no choice but to retreat.
He earnestly asked the young students present that as descendants of the Dragon Kingdom, they should bear in mind the original intention of their blood, be loyal to their family and country throughout their lives, and live up to their homeland.
The sincere speech touched people's hearts. The whole audience was silent and everyone was moved. Many students had tears in their eyes, and their feelings for home and country were completely ignited in their hearts.
When the speech came to an end, the applause lasted for a long time and echoed throughout the audience.
Lu Bu, who took the stage next, had a completely different style. He had an unruly expression and sharp words. He bluntly said that practicing cultivation in troubled times requires strength.
